metadata.name: YOYO B3-A Evidence Hierarchy
metadata.source_set: Y2K Color MVP Evaluation Set v1

fundamental_policy.official_identity: Only B2 physical modes at threshold 0.045 are official B3-A classification entities.
fundamental_policy.robustness_policy: 0.055 and 0.065 descendants are diagnostic-only and cannot promote or replace baseline evidence.
fundamental_policy.evidence_policy: Evidence Tier is determined exclusively from baseline 0.045 evidence.

metadata.methodological_note: Family coverage is informative but threshold-sensitive. Wider-threshold descendants are therefore used only to assess robustness, not to manufacture stronger baseline evidence.

grade_definition.A: Evidence Tier and Scope remain unchanged at 0.055 and 0.065.
grade_definition.B: Stable at 0.055; Evidence Tier or Scope changes by 0.065.
grade_definition.C: Evidence Tier or Scope changes already at 0.055.

robustness.policy: Diagnostic descendants never override the official baseline Evidence Tier or Scope.
